# TlsClient

**Class** · `ironwood.net.tls.TlsClient`

```java
public final class TlsClient implements Closeable
```

**Implements:** [`Closeable`](../../io/Closeable.md)

A verified, single-connection TLS 1.2/1.3 client. Close before freeing.
